research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ambiq Micro is developing very low power microcontroller systems and system on chip designs that use on-demand activation of memory paths during sleep or active modes, flexible and low power cache memory architecture, and memory modules with fine grained voltage adjustment capabilities. Work on adaptive voltage converter designs, systems for profiling power using ton pulses, and methods for generating power profile in low power processors supports efficient mixed signal solutions for wireless electronics.

overview_description.description:
Ambiq Micro is an early-stage fabless semiconductor company that is developing ultra-low-power mixed-signal solutions for a new generation of wireless electronics.

Ambiq Micro was founded in 2010 on the simple yet powerful notion that extremely low-power semiconductors are the key to the future of electronics. Through the use of their pioneering ultra-low-power technology, they help innovative companies around the world develop differentiated solutions that reduce or eliminate the need for batteries, lower overall system power, and maximize industrial design flexibility.

about_short_description.short_description: Ambiq Micro is a semiconductor manufacturing company that develops mixed-signal solutions for wireless electronics.

product.name: Apollo and Atomiq SoC Families
product.description: Ultra-low-power system-on-chip families for battery-powered edge devices, combining processing, sensing, connectivity, memory, and AI capabilities in compact semiconductor solutions.

product.name: SPOT Platform
product.description: Ambiq’s proprietary subthreshold power optimization technology for reducing semiconductor and system power consumption in battery-powered embedded devices.

product.name: Real-Time Clock (RTC) Products
product.description: Low-power real-time clock products for maintaining accurate time and calendar information in battery-powered electronic systems.

product.name: neuralSPOT SDK
product.description: An embedded software development kit for building applications and deploying AI workloads on Ambiq’s low-power SoCs.

product.name: helia AI Runtime Portfolio
product.description: AI runtime software components for optimizing and executing machine-learning workloads on resource-constrained edge devices powered by Ambiq SoCs.

product.name: AI Developer Kits
product.description: Application-focused software and development resources for implementing edge AI functions such as health analysis, sound recognition, sleep monitoring, and data compression.
